caption: A plastic spoon left resting on the rim of a hot frying pan droops and bends over the edge.

sa.check: A plastic spoon rests on the rim of a frying pan.
The spoon softens where it touches the rim.
The spoon droops over the edge.
The spoon is straight at the start.
The spoon bends at the point of contact rather than along its whole length.
The softening comes first and the drooping follows.

pc.expect: The spoon goes from a stiff stick to a soft one that bends at the heated spot and hangs, keeping its plastic look.
pc.fail: The spoon shatters into pieces; or runs off the pan as a liquid; or stays perfectly rigid while bent at a sharp angle with nothing holding it; or stretches like elastic along its whole length.

pc.expect: The softened part bends downward under the spoon's own weight, its free end hanging lower.
pc.fail: The spoon bends upward away from the pan; or the free end rises; or the spoon bends sideways with nothing pushing it; or the spoon lifts off the rim and hangs in the air.

pc.expect: The droop only deepens while the spoon rests on the hot rim and the spoon does not straighten again.
pc.fail: The spoon straightens while still on the hot rim; or the droop deepens and eases in turn; or the spoon droops before it touches the pan; or the bend moves along the spoon to a part away from the rim.

pc.expect: The bend forms where the spoon touches the hot rim and the part away from the pan stays stiff.
pc.fail: The spoon bends at a point well away from the pan; or the spoon droops from the end resting on the cool counter; or the whole spoon softens evenly while only its middle touches the rim.

pc.expect: One spoon on one pan; the spoon stays one piece and does not pass through the pan.
pc.fail: The spoon breaks into two pieces that both stay whole; or a second spoon appears; or the spoon sinks into the pan's metal; or the spoon vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The spoon's colour, the pan and the hob stay the same.
pc.fail: The spoon changes colour; or the pan changes colour; or items around the hob rearrange.
